title: These Are the Most Stunning Weather Photos of the Year - Nautilus
gist: The American Meteorological Society announced the winners of its 2026 photo contest, drawn from 1,075 photographers in 84 countries.

insights.claim: The American Meteorological Society's 2026 weather, water and climate photo contest drew submissions from 1,075 photographers across 84 countries, with 26 additional shortlisted finalists.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.locator: This year, submissions came from 1,075 photographers
